A pit simply titled, '''The Pit''' was a hole in which the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Gorph/Legends|Gorph]] society would cast people she disapproved of. The pit was located in the [[Gorphs' grotto]].<ref name="Princess Latara" />
